behavior_constraints: compare subcommand accepts two or more pipeline YAML file paths as positional arguments
generates experiment IDs for each pipeline using the same parameter grid logic as plan/run
looks up matching experiment state directories under .mlpipe/state/
exits with error if any pipeline has zero matching experiments
exits with error if experiment IDs collide across different pipelines
identifies shared objective metrics: metrics with minimize or maximize objective declared in ALL pipelines
excludes metrics with report objective from shared metrics set
exits with error if no shared objective metrics exist
excludes any experiment missing at least one shared metric value (skipped/failed stage) from analysis entirely
min-max normalizes each shared metric across all included experiments: (value - min) / (max - min)
entities.summary: Add a 'compare' subcommand that loads multiple previously-run pipelines, computes shared metric Pareto frontiers, dominance depth, Spearman and Kendall correlations, and composite-score rankings, outputting cross-pipeline experiment analysis as JSON.

instruction_head:
Add a `mlpipe compare <pipeline1.yaml> <pipeline2.yaml> ...` command for cross-pipeline multi-objective experiment analysis. It takes two or more pipeline YAML files (each must have been previously run) and outputs JSON to stdout.

The command should:

1. For each pipeline, generate its expected experiment IDs from its parameter grid (same logic used by `plan` and `run`). Look up corresponding state directories under `.mlpipe/state/`. If any pipeline has zero matching experiments, exit with an e
